entries.source: Setting to adjust foliage quality and densitiy.
Increase or decrease how long bots wait between firing single shots or bursts. Linear multiplier, so a value of 2.0 doubles the wait.
Setting to adjust visual fidelity. Changes maximal pixels per mesh for nanite. Lower settings can lead to pixelated foliage.
Define the volume of other players using in game voice chat.
Define how much player voices are influenced by distance to yourself.
How long after a bot searches your last known location before it returns to a peaceful state and de-aggros.
Be aware that enabling it can lead to worse performance.
Setting to change your Anti-Aliasing method. Recommended DLSS on most hardware.
Be careful — more enemies can hurt performance. Values over 2.0 are not recommended for normal gameplay.
After the guaranteed misses, each shot still has this chance (0 to 1) to miss on purpose for the next few seconds, so bots walk their fire onto a target instead of landing the first hits.

Translations are initially generated with AI and may contain mistakes. 

Help improve them by suggesting translations and voting on existing ones in our community localisation editor.

Together, we can build translations reviewed by the community.
Setting to have your health/stamina bar always visible, only if it has changed recently or entirely disable it.
The maximum distance, in meters, at which a bot can perceive an enemy.
When a bot starts shooting at a target, its shots are guaranteed to miss until it has aimed at that target for this many seconds. Starts over when the bot switches targets.

Setting to turn on/off Lumen. Recommended to turn on if hardware is capable of doing so. 
Enables Realtime Global Illumination.
Increase or decrease how long bots hold the trigger on full auto before they need to recover and re-aim.
Setting to adjust shadow quality. Uses Virtual Shadow Maps on High and Epic.

When you are in or near the spot a bot thinks you are, whether it heard or saw you there, it gains sight of you faster. This is how much faster, at most; the effect fades the further you are from that spot.
How far bots automatically share what they perceive with friendly bots. A bot that spots an enemy tells every friendly within this radius.
Setting to adjust Post Processing quality.  Enables volumetric effects like volmetric fog and clouds on High and Epic.
Angle in degrees from where a bot is looking within which it can see a target.
Allows bots to pick the head as the point they aim at.
Setting to toggle if the character should automatically go into low ready after being in idle for more than 10 seconds.
How much radio effect should be applied to player voices.
Increase or decrease how long bots wait before they can fire their first shots when aiming. Linear multiplier, so a value of 2.0 doubles the wait.
Setting to toggle the compass at the top for orientation.
If a bot is shooting at someone further than this distance, in meters, it switches to semi-auto. Closer than that it uses full auto when the weapon has it.
When a bot goes from being at peace or on patrol to combat, this is added on top of the base sense delay, so the first contact takes longer to react to.
Setting to toggle if the GCPS should beep when you are close to resources.
The lowest rate, in updates per second, at which distant bots still move. Higher values make bots look smoother at range at the cost of performance.
Lets bots notice an enemy's weapon laser.
Setting to set view distance. Lower setting means objects are culled earlier.
Setting to set overall quality level.
Controls the randomized spread bots have when shooting.
Wether you always want steady mic input or only when you press the Push-To-Talk button.
A multiplier that works on top of the base AI count on the map and the default AI coop multiplier.
This enabled NVIDIAs newest technology Ray Reconstruction. It greatly improves image quality by reducing noise and artifacts as well as providing a clearer image.
How much of a target has to be visible before a bot can see it at all. Lower values let bots spot targets that are barely peeking out.
Higher values = more spread and randomization.
At which distance should the radio effect be applied to player voices. Zero means it is always on. Measurement is in meters. Maximum distance is 100 meters.
You can change the keybinding in the corresponding tab.
Every sense on a bot has an enforced delay before it actually registers what it sensed. This is the base time for that delay, in seconds.
Low values can cause overly passive bots who sit and wait. High values can cause swarming in some situations.
Define how much player voices are influenced by occlusion of in game objects between them and the player.

Controls multiple behaviors, such as how long bots wait before searching for enemies, how likely they are to return fire on first contact, and how likely they take aggressive positions when given the opportunity.
How long, in seconds, a target has to stay in view before a bot reacts to it. Distance, light and weather make this longer or shorter.
Lets bots notice an enemy's flashlight.
Setting to toggle nameplates on your team mates.
Enable or disable bots suppressing the last known location of their enemy. If disabled, bots only shoot when they can see their enemy.

Toggle to show a dedicated notify when your weapon malfunctions or not. 

If turned off, you need to rely on the audio cue.
Multiplies all damage dealt by regular bots, to players and to other bots alike. 1.0 is unchanged, 2.0 doubles it.
Sets how hard the bots are: how fast they react, how well they see and aim, and how much damage is dealt. Pick Custom to change the settings below yourself.
Controls how much the AI costs your CPU in raid. Trades the visual quality and smoothness of distant bots for CPU overhead. Pick Custom to set the optimization ranges yourself.
Multiplies all damage dealt by bosses. 1.0 is unchanged, 2.0 doubles it.
When bots are further than this from every human player, their update rate and movement are slightly reduced to lower their CPU cost.
When bots are further than this from every human player, their update rate is moderately reduced and their movement physics are simplified.
When bots are further than this from every human player, their update rate is heavily reduced and their movement physics are at their simplest.
When bots are further than this from every human player, their movement is switched off entirely to lower their CPU cost.
Select Custom to change these settings.
Multiplies all damage dealt by players. 1.0 is unchanged, 2.0 doubles it.
